stateOwnerDisposition: Owns generation-fenced process lifecycle, durable bounded restart state and the unified durable release-transition journal; Fleet owns immutable release catalog/allow-revoke admission facts and user-task truth remains outside this module.
terminalObserverDisposition: The exact process driver, Agentd readiness/drain acknowledgements and current-generation observations establish lifecycle terminality; drain acknowledgement closes admission but never establishes user-task success.

operations.sourceSemantics: Creates a generation-fenced managed process. Unix post-spawn setup faults travel with the acquired process owner; failed initialization or lease publication retains an exact fenced main or Matrix handle until observed exit and same-owner cleanup. Constructor recovery prevalidates durable evidence, independently acquires exact main and Matrix owners, and isolates damaged Agent evidence without dropping unrelated owners. Adopted signals use kernel lifetime references on supported Linux/macOS hosts, never a bare-PID fallback. Daemon death before a recoverable lease and complete cross-daemon exit-cleanup reconciliation remain open. Every main launch repeats current canonical catalog admission before lifecycle or process effects; catalog-derived descriptors never downgrade to catalog-free plants after entry removal. Constructor-only pure idle hydration is observed at most 256 times and settled by a final complete Fleet read, complete AgentRecord equality and fresh absence of all eight durable witnesses; changed idle records use original fresh recovery, while acquired owners are retained and denied rather than re-adopted. No observation authorizes admission or mutation.

Consumes exact Agentd/process observations under the active generation, requires critical-store/revocation-baseline/required-port/admission readiness before Running, fences stale processes, and advances bounded durable restart/recovery state without inferring task success. Emit automatic restart attempts only after durable charge and exact lineage/deadline admission; exhaustion is a normal bounded policy outcome. Preserve independently observed concurrent admission, signal, probe and cleanup faults once in the bounded tick report. Fresh complete read metadata and physical lease readiness remain mandatory when unchanged per-Agent status projections are reused.

Transitions the lifecycle fence to Draining and requires an exact typed Agentd Drain acknowledgement for the current spawn/draining generation. Agentd first closes App Server admission and waits for already-admitted RPC handlers, then requires zero running assistant turns and zero unclassified durable Automation/TaskFlow blockers. Durable uncertain/indeterminate effects remain unknown for reconciliation rather than being relabelled complete. A crash after durable Draining replays the idempotent Drain RPC; unavailable drain evidence fails closed into bounded stop escalation, never a drain==SIGTERM shortcut. Recovery of an exact journaled Stop preserves its original durable deadline; a transient bound-control driver failure retains the staged control and does not skip independent signed-intent recovery. Complete crash-cut lineage and the atomic recovery-observation envelope remain open.

Before cancellation or signaling, persists a generation/process-bound Stop intent with its original deadline. Cancels an existing pending main restart through the canonical writer before companion deferral, lifecycle CAS and graceful signaling; preserves charged attempts, window origin, eligibility and companion budget. Recovery reuses that deadline and reconciles cancellation before journaled absence may complete the control. A stopped/failed Agent with no owned or leased processes can cancel its existing pending restart without inventing a process identity. Internal/deferred process stop preserves the restart it implements. Complete release-change/control supersession and cross-daemon exit-cleanup witnesses remain open. Process termination is not user-task success.

Attempts durable generation/process-bound Kill intent and pending-main-restart cancellation, then attempts the already-owned main process before independently entering the companion driver. Companion, registry, intent or cancellation failures cannot suppress the main emergency termination attempt; all failures remain reportable and retained owners stay fenced until observed exit. Adopted signals use kernel lifetime references; a signal acknowledgement is not observed exit. Complete release-change/control supersession, cross-daemon exit-cleanup witnesses and target-host qualification remain open.

Keeps an unresolved restart claim across budget-window rollover without resetting charged attempts or original eligibility. Admission, preflight and recovery reject wall-clock rollback before the window origin; internal/deferred Stop preserves the pending claim. Exact lineage binds the predecessor and any acquired replacement, and healthy completion retains its continuation until lineage and budget acknowledgement are durable. Replacement dispatch waits for exact Matrix exit and lease cleanup. A known driver spawn failure before acquiring a process cancels its exact charged claim; failed cancellation retains its witness, blocks competing dispatch and retries fresh durable acknowledgement without redispatch. Complete predecessor/replacement lineage across every launch-before-lease or rejected-adoption crash cut remains open.

Transitions through a fsynced unified release transaction that binds exact source/target immutable manifests/program bytes, the per-Agent allow/revoke admission frontier, the exact source/target pair identity, lifecycle/release-state generations and optional signed production authority. The pair digest is a structural binding, not independent semantic-compatibility approval; runtime compatibility is established by the typed Agentd/Matrixd readiness contract before commit. A production daemon configured with a verifier rejects unsigned Upgrade/Rollback.

Re-resolves the recorded predecessor at the final-use boundary, rejects revoked or allowance/frontier-drifted releases, verifies its immutable bytes against the durable transaction, and starts rollback only as a fresh process generation.

Admits a production upgrade only after independently signed H7 and production-grant verification binds exact source/target releases and current control/lifecycle/daemon-authority fences. The fsynced release transaction additionally binds immutable program digests plus the current per-Agent admission frontier before drain.

Admits production rollback only through an independently signed grant; the predecessor is freshly re-resolved and its manifest/program digests and current allow/revoke admission frontier must exactly match the durable transaction witness.

Quarantines ambiguous signed transitions as recovery_required while keeping owner-local status/recovery RPCs reachable. An independently signed recovery decision must bind the grant, signed-intent digest, release-transaction digest, observed immutable release bytes and current lifecycle/daemon-authority fences; the current admission frontier is revalidated again before terminal commit/rollback. Exact prepared source/target CAS generation and predecessor distinguish rollback-target success from failed-target source restoration. An interrupted terminal publication can resume only its exact signed decision after repeated verification, acknowledging both journals and advancing owner-local revision once; unrelated transaction digests are omitted from status.
